g.text: 1 = all on the same lunar day
White names and dots: separate studies. Only places with at least 12 spawning nights are shown. Latitude against tightness: Spearman ρ = -0.73, also found within genera.
Places with more recorded nights also look more spread out, so closer watching may explain part of this. Sources: Baird et al. (2021), Sheridan et al. (2025), Sakai et al. (2024).
In the tropics, 88% of spawning nights fall in the 8 days after full moon, just 27% of the lunar month.
Outside the tropics it drops to 51%. At Eilat and Kochi spawning spans almost the whole month.
The Moon’s hold loosens away from the equator
